name: Susegad Sound
tagline: A printed-paper guide to three days of dust, tide, and analog frequency
prompt: A zine-style companion app for an independent music festival in Goa: line-ups, stage maps and a personal schedule

spec.name: Susegad Sound
spec.world: Set at the Vagator Shoreline across three stages: The Banyan (ambient/noise), The Cove (disco/dub), and The Dunes (modular techno). Featuring artists like Lifafa (playing at 21:15 on Dec 14 at The Dunes), Peter Cat Recording Co. (sunset set at 17:40 on Dec 15 at The Banyan), and selector dynamic duo Sandunes (01:10 on Dec 16 at The Cove). Beer costs ₹250, salt-cured mackerel buns are ₹180, and high tide peaks at 19:42.

imagery.subject: A close-up shot of an indigo-ink risograph flyer lying on damp Vagator sand, with dried salt crystals catching the sunset light.
An abstract, two-tone screen print of a coconut palm tree silhouette overlapping with modular synthesizer patch cables.
A grainy black and white film photo of crowds dancing under the colossal roots of a lit-up Banyan tree at midnight.
A hand-drawn map illustration of the rocky Goa coast with bold, uneven neon-pink registration errors.

spec.summary: An independent festival companion that swaps clinical tech for the raw warmth of a risograph zine. Built for navigating the salt-air stages of Vagator, saving setlists, and keeping time by the sun.
spec.tagline: A printed-paper guide to three days of dust, tide, and analog frequency
spec.audience: Vinyl diggers, experimental electronic heads, and coastal drifters seeking off-beat frequencies in Goa.

directions.why: It perfectly channels the independent, anti-corporate DIY spirit of underground music zines.
directions.twist: A coarse ink-bleed simulator on the text and custom-designed halftones on artist photos that shift slightly in color when you shake the phone.

directions.why: Goa's basalt cliffs and heavy tides meet the raw energy of experimental noise and techno.
directions.twist: Monochrome high-contrast xerox textures, 90-degree rotated vertical stage names, and oversized navigation tabs that look like brutalist paper dividers.

directions.why: Aligns with the natural, laid-back coastal rhythm (Susegad) of Goa's beaches, palm groves, and sunset rituals.
directions.twist: Terracotta-toned mud textures, soft sun-faded sage greens, and custom hand-carved block prints representing local flora and tidal waves.

spec.heroObject: The living festival schedule: who is playing, which shore they are on, and the exact position of the tide.

directions.why: It perfectly channels the independent, anti-corporate DIY spirit of underground music zines.
directions.name: Oceanic Ink and Perforation
directions.pitch: A two-ink risograph fanzine that turns digital scheduling into tactile paper art using Overlapping Fluorescent Pink and Federal Blue.
directions.twist: A coarse ink-bleed simulator on the text and custom-designed halftones on artist photos that shift slightly in color when you shake the phone.
directions.motion: Quick mechanical shifts with a slight 1-degree tilt on tap, simulating physical paper handling.
directions.imagery: Two-ink risograph duotone with heavy ink grain and digital misregistration. Artists are rendered in extreme halftones of Fluorescent Pink over Federal Blue.
signature: A misregistered duplicate header layer offset by 2px in Fluorescent Pink
Perforated ticket borders dividing schedule stages with dashed lines
Rotated mono badges offset at exactly 15 degrees

directions.why: Goa's basalt cliffs and heavy tides meet the raw energy of experimental noise and techno.
directions.name: Basalt Tide
directions.pitch: Raw physical structure mirroring Vagator's jagged black cliffs, featuring high-contrast dithered frames and unyielding structural grids.
directions.twist: Monochrome high-contrast xerox textures, 90-degree rotated vertical stage names, and oversized navigation tabs that look like brutalist paper dividers.
directions.motion: Zero easing. State changes are immediate 0ms jumps to emphasize digital raw mechanics.
directions.imagery: Flash photography processed through brutalist high-contrast Xerox textures and dithered black and white patterns. Zero color photography.
signature: Vertical stage labels rotated 90 degrees aligning to block edges
Oversized navigation tabs styled after physical archive dividers
Aggressive horizontal lines slicing every single content block

directions.name: Monsoon Terrace
directions.pitch: A slow-paced, earthy layout using natural terracotta-tints and warm basalt stone shades that lets you keep time with Vagator's tides.
directions.twist: Terracotta-toned mud textures, soft sun-faded sage greens, and custom hand-carved block prints representing local flora and tidal waves.
directions.motion: Soft, natural fades of 350ms with a slight decelerating slide to simulate physical book reading.
directions.imagery: Warm, high-grain analog film photos of red-clay pathways, ocean tides crashing, and slow fermentation plates with heavy natural shadows.
signature: Warm photographic plates overlapping organic text headers
Dotted leaders linking acts to their corresponding tide-levels
Gentle asymmetrical offsets that shift content like falling leaves
